headerDisplay: Tapo energy monitoring. Simulation is opt-in; the platform stays idle until at least one simulated device is configured. Cloud diagnostics are read-only and are not yet connected to live aggregation.
footerDisplay: History is stored only in the Homebridge storage directory. Tapo account credentials entered for a cloud diagnostic are not saved in plugin settings.

simulationMode.title: Simulation mode
simulationMode.description: Enable only to run an explicit simulation. The platform stays idle by default.

enableMatterMeter.title: Publish Matter Electrical Meter
enableMatterMeter.description: Requires Matter enabled on this Homebridge bridge and Homebridge 2.5.0 or later. Publishes an Electrical Meter device with estimated totals only; real Tapo counters will be kept separate.

simulatedDevices.title: Simulated devices
simulatedDevices.description: Add at least one row to explicitly start simulation. Empty list means the platform remains idle.

tapoCloudPython.title: Python executable for Tapo cloud
tapoCloudPython.description: Use python3 or an absolute path to a Python 3.10+ virtual-environment interpreter.
